FOCIL implements a robust mechanism to preserve Ethereum’s censorship resistance properties by guaranteeing timely transaction inclusion.
In each slot, a set of validators is selected as inclusion list (IL) committee members.
Attesters only vote for the proposer's block if it includes transactions from all stored ILs.

quadratic funding mechanisms rely on donations to measure preference for certain options among different public good projects.
Each donation counts as a "vote" for a specific project, with projects that receive more votes getting more funds from the matching pool.
Using onchain voting makes quadratic funding susceptible to collusion: blockchain transactions are public, so bribers can inspect a bribee’s onchain activity to see how they “voted”.
